t: Notwithstanding section 1101, the level for “The Judiciary, Courts of Appeals, District Courts, and Other Judicial Services, Defender Services” shall be $1,040,000,000.

fable.w: This provision only sets an appropriations level for the judiciary's Defender Services account. The mention of courts and defender services might suggest litigation or outside involvement, but nothing here grants a right to sue, requires consultation, or brings any non-federal party into a federal decision. It is purely a funding provision.
fable.s: the level for “The Judiciary, Courts of Appeals, District Courts, and Other Judicial Services, Defender Services” shall be $1,040,000,000.
